limitations.note: The agent corrected the exact-payment and overpayment behavior for beverage 2, but replaced the state-decoded outputs with registered outputs and changed how coins and change are handled instead of fixing just the two output encodings.

The test generated expected outputs from the same edge-detection, credit, and queued-change assumptions as the rewrite, so its 10,025 passing cycles did not verify that the original FSM behavior was preserved.
The final check tried Git in a non-repository and repeated a standalone compile that had already passed, without any intervening changes.
